(RS_CRYPTO_02206)
7.4.1.2 Key Derivation Function (KDF)
According to [10], [11], [12], and [13] the Key Derivation Function (
KDF
) shall prevent
that an attacker, when a derived key was obtained, will gather information about the
master secret value or other derived keys. It is also important to strengthen the derived
key to prevent an attacker to guess or to brute force the derived key. Therefore, good
keys are derived by adding a
Salt
, which avoids dictionary attacks, and a number of
iterations, which increase the guessing delay.
